title: I found my “Virginia Beach” resort/hotel
content: And this is both unsettling and astounding. I have been making a lot of connections to MW places irl. Anyone else “been” here? This is where it’s always storming outside, the dorm floors start at Floor 2. I am so geeked out by finding that my MW reference for a place weirdly checks out irl. The photos above are all from the hotel website. My faves in the comments.
